messages:
maria: Quick q — we have a hotpatch ready for tomorrow's 9-10am change window (low risk). Do we pin minor or just bump the patch? Also what's our git tag convention for hotpatches? cc @alex @jonah

alex: my take: patch bump only for bugfixes. If there's any public API change, go minor. For hotpatches, prefer a clean semver tag like `v1.4.4` and keep metadata in the release body. Avoid ad-hoc suffixes that users might depend on. :thumbsup:

jonah: +1 to simple tags. Operationally, we need traceability — include `hotpatch/1728504321` in the release notes and artifact name, but tag the repo `v1.4.4`. That makes rollback straightforward (tag points to exact commit).

tim: ops note: deploy-bot's rollback ledger looks for unique tag -> image digest mapping. If we reuse the same tag name across builds we risk ambiguity. Can we standardize to `v{MAJOR}.{MINOR}.{PATCH}` git tag + artifact named `{project}-v{semver}-hotfix-{build}`? Then the rollback job can reference the artifact digest.

sarah: i like that compromise. users see normal semver; infra keeps the hotfix trace in artifacts. Also, please make sure the lockfile is updated/pinned in the PR. Hotpatches are where accidental dependency drift bites us.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy queued by @maria for pipeline `release/v1.4.4` in change window 2024-07-10T09:00Z-10:00Z. Canary plan: 5% for 20m, then 50% for 10m, then full. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 1728504321`. Rollback job: `jobs/rollback-by-digest` (requires image digest).

maria: sounds good. plan: create PR with lockfile pin, publish tag `v1.4.4` (annotated), build artifact `redwood-inference-v1.4.4-hotfix-1728504321.tar.gz`, add release notes with `hotpatch/1728504321` section. I'll kick the deploy in the 9am window.

alex: couple of asks: 1) add a one-line in release notes describing the customer impact, 2) enable prompt-eval hooks for the hotpatch (we run a small smoke eval set), 3) set alert on error rate surge > 1% during canary.

jonah: also tag the rollback job with the exact image digest in the PR description so SREs can schedule a dry-run quickly if needed.

tim: ack, i'll queue a rollback dry-run after canary passes.

maria: thanks all — consensus: patch bump only (`v1.4.4`), artifacts include hotpatch build id, release notes include hotpatch id and one-liner, deploy-bot will run canary. I'll open the PR now. :raising_hand:

sarah: :rocket: make sure to add a short note in the change window doc about the quick rollback plan.

alex: final: document this as our hotpatch pattern in the release playbook (semver tag + artifact hotfix id + lockfile pin + digest-backed rollback). I'll add a PR to docs after this deploy.
